data.text: Start your Austrian adventure at the picturesque Zell am See, where alpine charm meets world-class skiing. This stunning resort sits between the crystalline Lake Zell and the majestic Schmittenhöhe mountain, offering breathtaking panoramic views from every angle. With 77 kilometers of diverse pistes ranging from gentle beginner slopes to challenging black runs, Zell am See caters to all skill levels. The resort’s state-of-the-art lift system ensures minimal waiting times. At the same time, its charming medieval town center provides a perfect après-ski atmosphere with traditional Austrian restaurants and cozy bars where you can relax after your first exhilarating day on the slopes.

On your second day, experience the expansive Skicircus Saalbach Hinterglemm Leogang Fieberbrunn, one of Austria’s largest interconnected ski areas. Saalbach offers an impressive 270 kilometers of slopes across a vast ski network with modern infrastructure, including 70 lifts and cable cars. Famous for its perfectly groomed runs and exceptional snow reliability, Saalbach is a paradise for intermediate skiers with its abundance of red runs. However, beginners and experts will find plenty to enjoy as well. The resort is equally renowned for its lively après-ski scene, with the pedestrianized village center buzzing with energy as skiers and snowboarders gather to share stories of their day’s adventures on the mountain.

Discover the hidden gem of Austria’s ski scene at Hochkönig, part of the Ski Amadé network. This resort combines three picturesque villages—Maria Alm, Dienten, and Mühlbach—into one remarkable ski experience with 120 kilometers of interconnected slopes. Hochkönig’s unique selling point is its “König’s Tour,” a scenic circuit that allows skiers to traverse the entire resort area in a single day, enjoying stunning views of the imposing Hochkönig massif throughout the journey. The resort maintains its authentic Alpine character, with traditional mountain huts serving regional specialties, offering visitors a taste of genuine Austrian hospitality while enjoying less-crowded slopes than those of some of the country’s more famous destinations.

Prepare for an unforgettable day at the legendary Kitzbühel, home to the world’s most famous downhill ski race—the Hahnenkamm. This sophisticated resort combines medieval charm with skiing heritage, boasting 233 kilometers of meticulously maintained pistes across several interconnected mountains. Kitzbühel’s varied terrain offers something for everyone, from gentle nursery slopes to the hair-raising Streif downhill course that challenges even professional skiers. Beyond the exceptional skiing, Kitzbühel enchants visitors with its colorful, car-free town center featuring frescoed buildings, exclusive boutiques, and gourmet restaurants. The resort’s blend of tradition, luxury, and world-class skiing facilities makes it the crown jewel of Tyrolean ski destinations.

Conclude your Austrian ski tour with an ascent to Kitzsteinhorn, Salzburg’s only glacier ski resort, offering snow-sure conditions year-round up to an altitude of 3,029 meters. This high-alpine winter playground provides 41 kilometers of pristine slopes with spectacular panoramic views extending across Austria’s highest peaks. The Kitzsteinhorn experience goes beyond skiing with attractions like the “Gipfelwelt 3000” summit station featuring the National Park Gallery, Cinema 3000, and viewing platforms offering breathtaking vistas of the Hohe Tauern National Park. Advanced riders will appreciate the resort’s five snowparks and the natural half-pipes of the Superpipe, while powder enthusiasts can explore marked freeride routes with deep, untouched snow even late in the season.

Discover Europe's best-kept skiing secret with our Catski & Freeride Touring adventure in Kosovo's magnificent Šar Mountains. This 6-day powder expedition combines efficient snowcat access to remote terrain with authentic Balkan mountain culture for a truly unique winter experience. Unlike crowded Alpine destinations, Kosovo offers pristine, untouched snow that stays fresh for days across diverse terrain—from wide-open bowls to perfectly spaced tree runs and challenging steeps. With over 4000m of daily vertical descent and more than 40 distinct lines between 2400-2600m elevation, you'll experience world-class powder at a fraction of Western European prices. Perfect for intermediate to advanced riders seeking adventure beyond mainstream destinations, this tour includes comfortable mountain accommodation, traditional Kosovar cuisine, and the warm hospitality that makes the Balkans special.

Deep in the Balkans lies Europe’s last untamed powder frontier—a place where pristine lines await those brave enough to claim them before the world discovers this hidden gem.

The Accursed Mountains of Kosovo offer what has become mythical in today’s crowded European ski scene: genuine powder exploration. For seven unforgettable days, you’ll venture beyond conventional boundaries through a strategic combination of cat-powered access and tactical touring. This hybrid approach unlocks terrain previously inaccessible by traditional means, delivering you to descents that remain untouched even days after the last snowfall.

This isn’t merely a guided ski trip—it’s a technical backcountry expedition. Based at the remote Gacaferi Guest House, perched at 1,840m and surrounded by ancient pine forests, you’ll push your riding to new heights while immersing in authentic Balkan culture. Our experienced guides know every hidden bowl, technical chute, and gladed sanctuary in these mountains, strategically progressing your group through increasingly rewarding terrain as skills and confidence build throughout the week.

Fuel your powder pursuits with hearty, authentic Balkan cuisine prepared from local ingredients. Breakfasts feature homemade breads, local cheeses, and farm-fresh eggs. Pack lunches are provided for mountain days, while dinners showcase traditional specialties including slow-cooked meats, savory pies, and regional delicacies. Dietary restrictions can be accommodated with advance notice.

Fly into Pristina International Airport (PRN), Kosovo’s main gateway with connections to major European cities. Shared transfers to and from the airport are included in your package, with coordinated pickup and drop-off times based on the group’s arrival schedule. The scenic drive to the Accursed Mountains takes approximately 2.5 hours, providing your first glimpse of Kosovo’s dramatic landscapes.

data.text: Conquer Kosovo's Hidden Powder Paradise: Ultimate Catski & Freeride Adventure!

Discover Europe's best-kept skiing secret with our Catski & Freeride Touring adventure in Kosovo's magnificent Šar Mountains. This 6-day powder expedition combines efficient snowcat access to remote terrain with authentic Balkan mountain culture for a truly unique winter experience. Unlike crowded Alpine destinations, Kosovo offers pristine, untouched snow that stays fresh for days across diverse terrain—from wide-open bowls to perfectly spaced tree runs and challenging steeps. With over 4000m of daily vertical descent and more than 40 distinct lines between 2400-2600m elevation, you'll experience world-class powder at a fraction of Western European prices. Perfect for intermediate to advanced riders seeking adventure beyond mainstream destinations, this tour includes comfortable mountain accommodation, traditional Kosovar cuisine, and the warm hospitality that makes the Balkans special.
Ride it DEEP, STEEP & DOWN!
Trip Details: The Ultimate Balkan Freeride Experience

Our carefully crafted expedition combines the efficiency of cat-skiing with the adventure of ski touring to access terrain impossible to reach by conventional means. Each day is carefully planned to maximize quality riding time while minimizing exhaustion. Our expert guides analyze weather patterns, snow conditions, and group energy levels to select the perfect zones each day. data.text: Lofoten Floating Basecamp: Ski & Snowboard Freeride Touring Adventure

Carve pristine Arctic powder by day and sail the breathtaking Norwegian fjords by night on Snowbusters’ exclusive Lofoten   Arctic Powder Sail, a freeride touring expedition. This unique 5-person floating basecamp experience takes you to remote peaks rising directly from turquoise waters, unlocking summit-to-sea freeride lines impossible to reach by land. With daily repositioning by boat, you’ll explore fresh terrain every day, maximizing your descent quality and quantity in one of the world’s most spectacular backcountry playgrounds.
Ride it DEEP, STEEP & DOWN!
Trip Details: What to Expect on the Lofoten Boat Expedition

This is not your typical ski trip. The LOFOTEN BOAT expedition combines expert backcountry touring with the adventure of life aboard a cozy, specialized vessel navigating Norway’s Lofoten archipelago. Each day, you’ll wake up to new terrain as the boat moves to the best fjord locations, giving you access to untouched powder stashes and breathtaking freeride lines.

Guided by an experienced IFMGA/UIAGM-certified mountain guide, you’ll ascend stunning Arctic peaks using your touring gear, then enjoy exhilarating descents directly to the shoreline where your floating basecamp awaits. Expect to cover 1000-1500 meters of ascent daily, with multiple laps possible on varied terrain ranging from moderate to challenging freeride routes.

The maritime snowpack offers a dynamic mix of powder, wind-affected snow, and spring corn conditions, ensuring diverse and rewarding skiing or splitboarding. After your summit-to-sea runs, relax in warm cabins, savor hearty Norwegian cuisine, and if lucky, witness the Northern Lights dancing above the fjords.

Carve pristine Arctic powder by day and sail the breathtaking Norwegian fjords by night on Snowbusters’ exclusive Lofoten   Arctic Powder Sail, a freeride touring expedition. This unique 5-person floating basecamp experience takes you to remote peaks rising directly from turquoise waters, unlocking summit-to-sea freeride lines impossible to reach by land. Ride it DEEP, STEEP & DOWN!
Trip Details: What to Expect on the LOFOTEN BOAT Expedition

This is not your typical ski trip. The LOFOTEN BOAT expedition combines expert backcountry touring with the adventure of life aboard a cozy, specialized vessel navigating Norway’s Lofoten archipelago. Each day, you’ll wake up to new terrain as the boat moves to the best fjord locations, giving you access to untouched powder stashes and breathtaking freeride lines.

Expect to cover 1000-1500 meters of ascent daily, with multiple laps possible on varied terrain ranging from moderate to challenging freeride routes.

The maritime snowpack offers a dynamic mix of powder, wind-affected snow, and spring corn conditions, ensuring diverse and rewarding skiing or splitboarding. After your summit-to-sea runs, relax in warm cabins, savor hearty Norwegian cuisine, and if lucky, witness the Northern Lights dancing above the fjords.

data.text: Start your Austrian adventure at the picturesque Zell am See, where alpine charm meets world-class skiing. This stunning resort sits between the crystalline Lake Zell and the majestic Schmittenhöhe mountain, offering breathtaking panoramic views from every angle. With 77 kilometers of diverse pistes ranging from gentle beginner slopes to challenging black runs, Zell am See caters to all skill levels. The resort’s state-of-the-art lift system ensures minimal waiting times. At the same time, its charming medieval town center provides a perfect après-ski atmosphere with traditional Austrian restaurants and cozy bars where you can relax after your first exhilarating day on the slopes.

On your second day, experience the expansive Skicircus Saalbach Hinterglemm Leogang Fieberbrunn, one of Austria’s largest interconnected ski areas. Saalbach offers an impressive 270 kilometers of slopes across a vast ski network with modern infrastructure, including 70 lifts and cable cars. Famous for its perfectly groomed runs and exceptional snow reliability, Saalbach is a paradise for intermediate skiers with its abundance of red runs. However, beginners and experts will find plenty to enjoy as well. The resort is equally renowned for its lively après-ski scene, with the pedestrianized village center buzzing with energy as skiers and snowboarders gather to share stories of their day’s adventures on the mountain.

Discover the hidden gem of Austria’s ski scene at Hochkönig, part of the Ski Amadé network. This resort combines three picturesque villages—Maria Alm, Dienten, and Mühlbach—into one remarkable ski experience with 120 kilometers of interconnected slopes. Hochkönig’s unique selling point is its “König’s Tour,” a scenic circuit that allows skiers to traverse the entire resort area in a single day, enjoying stunning views of the imposing Hochkönig massif throughout the journey. The resort maintains its authentic Alpine character, with traditional mountain huts serving regional specialties, offering visitors a taste of genuine Austrian hospitality while enjoying less-crowded slopes than those of some of the country’s more famous destinations.

Prepare for an unforgettable day at the legendary Kitzbühel, home to the world’s most famous downhill ski race—the Hahnenkamm. This sophisticated resort combines medieval charm with skiing heritage, boasting 233 kilometers of meticulously maintained pistes across several interconnected mountains. Kitzbühel’s varied terrain offers something for everyone, from gentle nursery slopes to the hair-raising Streif downhill course that challenges even professional skiers. Beyond the exceptional skiing, Kitzbühel enchants visitors with its colorful, car-free town center featuring frescoed buildings, exclusive boutiques, and gourmet restaurants. The resort’s blend of tradition, luxury, and world-class skiing facilities makes it the crown jewel of Tyrolean ski destinations.

Conclude your Austrian ski tour with an ascent to Kitzsteinhorn, Salzburg’s only glacier ski resort, offering snow-sure conditions year-round up to an altitude of 3,029 meters. This high-alpine winter playground provides 41 kilometers of pristine slopes with spectacular panoramic views extending across Austria’s highest peaks. The Kitzsteinhorn experience goes beyond skiing with attractions like the “Gipfelwelt 3000” summit station featuring the National Park Gallery, Cinema 3000, and viewing platforms offering breathtaking vistas of the Hohe Tauern National Park. Advanced riders will appreciate the resort’s five snowparks and the natural half-pipes of the Superpipe, while powder enthusiasts can explore marked freeride routes with deep, untouched snow even late in the season.

Discover Europe's best-kept skiing secret with our Catski & Freeride Touring adventure in Kosovo's magnificent Šar Mountains. This 6-day powder expedition combines efficient snowcat access to remote terrain with authentic Balkan mountain culture for a truly unique winter experience. Unlike crowded Alpine destinations, Kosovo offers pristine, untouched snow that stays fresh for days across diverse terrain—from wide-open bowls to perfectly spaced tree runs and challenging steeps. With over 4000m of daily vertical descent and more than 40 distinct lines between 2400-2600m elevation, you'll experience world-class powder at a fraction of Western European prices. Perfect for intermediate to advanced riders seeking adventure beyond mainstream destinations, this tour includes comfortable mountain accommodation, traditional Kosovar cuisine, and the warm hospitality that makes the Balkans special.

data.text: Lofoten Floating Basecamp: Ski & Snowboard Freeride Touring Adventure

Carve pristine Arctic powder by day and sail the breathtaking Norwegian fjords by night on Snowbusters’ exclusive Lofoten   Arctic Powder Sail, a freeride touring expedition. This unique 5-person floating basecamp experience takes you to remote peaks rising directly from turquoise waters, unlocking summit-to-sea freeride lines impossible to reach by land. With daily repositioning by boat, you’ll explore fresh terrain every day, maximizing your descent quality and quantity in one of the world’s most spectacular backcountry playgrounds.
Ride it DEEP, STEEP & DOWN!
Trip Details: What to Expect on the Lofoten Boat Expedition

This is not your typical ski trip. The LOFOTEN BOAT expedition combines expert backcountry touring with the adventure of life aboard a cozy, specialized vessel navigating Norway’s Lofoten archipelago. Each day, you’ll wake up to new terrain as the boat moves to the best fjord locations, giving you access to untouched powder stashes and breathtaking freeride lines.

Guided by an experienced IFMGA/UIAGM-certified mountain guide, you’ll ascend stunning Arctic peaks using your touring gear, then enjoy exhilarating descents directly to the shoreline where your floating basecamp awaits. Expect to cover 1000-1500 meters of ascent daily, with multiple laps possible on varied terrain ranging from moderate to challenging freeride routes.

The maritime snowpack offers a dynamic mix of powder, wind-affected snow, and spring corn conditions, ensuring diverse and rewarding skiing or splitboarding. After your summit-to-sea runs, relax in warm cabins, savor hearty Norwegian cuisine, and if lucky, witness the Northern Lights dancing above the fjords.

Additional Considerations: Willingness to live in close quarters aboard a small vessel, preparedness for possible seasickness, and preferably bringing your own touring or splitboarding equipment are required.

data.text: Freeride Touring in Sunnmøre Alps – 5 Days of Epic Backcountry Adventure

Chase fresh powder and epic freeride lines in Norway’s legendary Sunnmøre Alps! This 5-day motorhome-based freeride touring trip delivers nonstop mountain time, steep fjord-to-peak descents, and expert coaching — all in one of Europe’s most stunning backcountry playgrounds. Get ready to tour up, shred down, and level up your freeride skills in pure Nordic powder.
Ultimate Norwegian Powder Mission: Freeride Touring in Sunnmøre Alps!

This trip is all about maximizing your time on the snow with quality and quantity riding. Each day, you’ll skin up 1000-1500 vertical meters to access untouched freeride lines ranging from wide-open powder fields to steep, technical couloirs. Forget waiting in lift lines — we use touring to unlock the best descents directly from the mountain, following fresh snow and ideal conditions.

Living in fully equipped motorhomes lets us chase the best powder zones daily, waking up right at the trailhead. Expect a dynamic, flexible adventure with expert guides who coach you on touring technique, avalanche safety, and confident big mountain riding. This is freeride touring at its finest — pure freedom, epic terrain, and serious progression.

data.text: Arctic Powder Quest: Ultimate Freeride Touring Adventure in Norway's Lyngen Alps!

Discover the magic of Arctic powder with our 6-day Freeride Touring adventure in Norway's spectacular Lyngen Alps. This extraordinary expedition combines world-class ski terrain, where 1,800m peaks rise dramatically from pristine fjords, with the ultimate flexibility of mobile motorhome accommodations that follow optimal conditions. Under expert guidance, you'll develop essential backcountry skills while experiencing the unique phenomenon of extended Arctic daylight and the possibility of northern lights. Perfect for confident black-run skiers and snowboarders with good fitness, this adventure offers 1000-1500m daily vertical of pristine descents in one of the planet's most breathtaking landscapes. You'll even test premium equipment through our exclusive DOWN SKIS demo program while immersing yourself in authentic Norwegian mountain culture.
DISCOVER THE MAJESTIC MOUNTAINS WHERE FJORDS MEET POWDER

This 6-day expedition takes you deep into the Lyngen Alps, where towering 1,800m peaks rise straight from pristine fjords. Each day, you’ll climb 1000-1500 vertical meters on skis or splitboards, chasing perfect snow and untouched lines far from crowded resorts. Our mobile motorhome base lets us follow optimal conditions, maximizing your time on the slopes. Expect varied terrain—from mellow powder fields to steep couloirs—offering endless freeride possibilities. Alongside epic skiing, you’ll sharpen your backcountry skills with expert avalanche safety training and technique coaching, ensuring you ride smarter and safer.
